purpose: Wake the project-persistent Controller from typed campaign observations, mint one bounded goal, and route safe work without an outside prompt.

existing_task_lifecycle.event_finalization_rule: After a host event finalizes, reread the exact task index, turn status, process set, and material receipt before progress or recovery is accepted.
existing_task_lifecycle.same_task_rule: STOP, finalized idle, unchanged custody, zero process, harmless probe, and substantive retry are exhausted before one role-locked replacement may be authorized.
existing_task_lifecycle.routing_rule: Candidate, audit, remediation, and next-seam work routes directly to the lane lead; only typed evidence-complete TRUE_BLOCKED crosses to the campaign Orchestrator.

autonomous_task_selection.rule: When a project adapter supplies an ordered typed task queue, the Controller selects the first open safe task by priority and stable ID; it never requires an outside task name.
autonomous_task_selection.boundary_rule: Hard boundaries stop first, soft boundaries go to Orchestrator review, repair puzzles route through campaign custody, and an empty or inactive workflow triggers liveness reconciliation and safe next-task recovery before any wait.

observation.source_rule: The observation is compiled from current control-plane records, exact source identity, active campaign state, handoffs, findings, and permission boundaries.
observation.identity_rule: A caller-supplied label is not accepted as proof of a runtime, external, repository, or deployment identity.
observation.freshness_rule: The source commit, source tree, parent handoff digest, and observation digest are read back before a goal is routed.

goal.one_at_a_time_rule: One observation produces one deterministic bounded goal. An equivalent observation produces the same goal identity.
goal.scope_rule: A safe repair stays within the current campaign and control plane. A scope change is reviewed before changed work continues.
goal.no_inference_rule: The goal cannot infer Product writes, Product agents, credentials, external deployment, release, publication, push, merge, or destructive work.

boundary_behavior.hard: Stop the dependent route and retain exact evidence for owner or protected-authority review.
boundary_behavior.soft: Ask the campaign Orchestrator to review the changed scope or operating choice while unrelated safe work continues.
boundary_behavior.puzzle: Route one bounded repair through the existing campaign custody, then require Auditor and Controller rechecks.
boundary_behavior.liveness: Observe active roles and receipts and repair safe liveness gaps without changing owner intent.
boundary_behavior.idle: Compatibility-only legacy label; an inactive or empty workflow is reconciled before waiting. An unchanged observation after a routed action is a liveness defect: persist a durable no-progress RCA and perform one bounded recovery. ACTIVE_EVENT_WAIT is valid only when the routed tick records an explicit authorized resume event and condition.
boundary_behavior.event_driven_wait: Remain alive with zero workers only when the routed readback records an exact resume event and condition or a protected dependency. Otherwise persist a no-progress RCA and repair the workflow before any wait.

routing_readback.identity_rule: A routed tick requires controller_role=AGENTOS_CONTROLLER and a known status. A caller-supplied handler, arbitrary status, or identity-free object is rejected.
routing_readback.source_binding_rule: Every routed result binds a task_id or a complete source_commit/source_tree pair; soft review binds an explicit next_action; an authorized wait binds resume_event_id and resume_condition.
routing_readback.claim_rule: semantic_progress, repaired, accepted, and approved claims require a content-addressed before/after transition or route receipt; the boolean claim alone is never progress.
routing_readback.action_rule: WAIT_FOR_AUTHORIZED_WORK is valid only with the exact event binding, REVIEW_SOFT_BOUNDARY is not same-turn progress, and external_action/product_action claims are denied.
routing_readback.same_turn_rule: The runtime continues a routed turn only after the validated readback carries a semantic before/after transition or a non-null route receipt digest.

persistence.records: Content-addressed records use compare-and-swap parent checks and regular non-symlink files.
persistence.failure_rule: A route failure is retained as an exact repairable record; it does not become an owner question unless it crosses a hard boundary or remains materially ambiguous.
persistence.history_rule: Each observation has its own goal and tick record; a changed observation preserves the prior failed route under a source-bound failure RCA before a new route is attempted.

cadence.rule: The running supervisor uses the bound policy interval for repeated observation and never treats a heartbeat without concrete result as progress.
